resources.string: The first-day questions, with the preview

Sofadrop makes wallpapers with the movies and shows you choose, for Projectivy and as a screensaver.\n\nA few questions, and you see how it looks at each one. You can change everything later in Settings.
Skip and use the recommended settings
Trending on TMDB, the complete style and 1080p
Pick one and the preview shows it. More details (ratings, cast, languages) in Settings → Wallpaper details.
Pick one or more. None of them needs an account, except your own list.
This week\'s most watched movies and shows
The best rated movies and shows on TMDB
Connect Trakt or Simkl with your phone to use your watchlist
Up to 200 per update; Projectivy shows a random 100 of them at a time. 4K is sharper on a 4K TV, but slower to make and bigger.
This TV has memory enough for it
Installed on this TV: %1$s. The trailer if it\'s on none of them
No streaming platform installed on this TV
When the remote isn\'t touched, the TV shows the wallpapers full screen, with a clock.
On Google TV it\'s switched on once from a computer: the last step shows how.
Lists and a look of its own, later in Settings → Screensaver
Switch it on once from a computer

Google TV doesn't list other apps' screensavers in its settings: it takes a computer on the same Wi-Fi, once.

This TV's address: %1$s

The QR code opens these steps, with pictures, on your phone.
Settings → System → About → press OK 7 times on \"Android TV OS build\".
Settings → System → Developer options → Wireless debugging → \"Pair device with pairing code\". Leave that screen open.
On the computer, with adb (Android\'s platform-tools)

adb pair %1$s:PORT CODE
adb connect %1$s:PORT
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_components %2$s

The pairing port and code are on the TV's screen; the port to connect to is under Wireless debugging.
Projectivy → Settings → Appearance → Launcher Idle Mode → turn off \"Prevent system screensaver\", then restart the TV.
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_components %1$s
